title: Martians, keep out!

The story unfolds with Scatterday's growth as a character, as he navigates dangerous encounters, rallies supporters, and ultimately inspires a strike among Martian workers, demonstrating the potential for solidarity and change against deep-rooted injustices. Through a mix of suspense and compelling character development, Leiber crafts a thought-provoking tale that challenges readers' perceptions of societal structures and the nature of humanity.
